# CIVILIAN HAZARD GUIDANCE [italic]Read this before you need it. You will not have time after.[/italic]
On a quiet day you will see a patrol in suits pass the mess and nothing more. When the Commanding Officer raises the alert state, the rules below apply to everyone.
## AT A CHECKPOINT - Stop when told to stop. Keep your hands where the sentry can see them. - Have your colony ID ready. Contractors also show a current work order. - Declare any firearm before you are searched. Weapons without a Colonial Marshal licence are confiscated and logged. - You may be scanned or sent through decontamination. It is cold. It is quick. It is not optional. - Do not photograph or record checkpoints, sentry posts or troop movements.
## CURFEW - Curfew hours are posted on this board and called over the colony PA. - Movement after curfew needs a pass from Colony Administration or the detachment duty officer. Essential workers keep theirs on them.
## WHEN THE SIREN SOUNDS - Mask first. Then get indoors, away from windows, and seal the door if you can. Stay there until the all clear. - Follow your block warden. Do not come to the garrison gate; it will be closed. - Shelter locations are listed by [netlink="Colony Administration" link="admin.colony.gov"].
## WHAT TO REPORT - A gas alarm sounding, or a gas monitor that is dark, damaged or tampered with. Carbon monoxide has no smell; the monitor is your nose. - Spills, leaking canisters, strange smells, dead animals or anyone suddenly sick. - Unattended bags, crates or vehicles. - Strangers asking about patrol times, the armoury or the landing pad. - Cut fences, broken locks, missing explosives or mining charges.
We do not ask about your politics. We do ask that you do not carry a rifle for anyone, or a canister.
## WHAT WE DO NOT DO Marines do not collect debts, settle disputes between neighbours or enforce Company contracts. Take those to the Colonial Marshals or to Administration. A complaint about a Marine goes in writing to the Executive Officer. Every complaint is logged and answered.
